transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I guess I'm here because... well, I just can't shake this feeling that I've completely ruined things for everyone. I've been falling really behind at work, and I kind of lost control of the apartment situation. It just feels like I deserve whatever bad thing happens to me next.
Have you been having thoughts of wanting to die or kill yourself?

I don't have a plan to actually hurt myself or anything like that. But... I do catch myself thinking that it would just be easier if I didn't wake up. It just feels like if I wasn't around, nobody would have to deal with me anymore.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event?

Yeah, I suppose they did. It's been going on for about a year and two months now. A pipe burst at my old place, which... well, it forced me to move into a smaller apartment. After that, all my normal routines just kind of fell apart, and I've been feeling like this ever since.
Did these feelings continue after the moving situation had already been resolved?

I'm not really sure what you mean by resolved. I mean, I'm still living in that smaller apartment, so it's just kind of my life now. But... yeah, the feelings never stopped. They've just been there the whole time since it happened.
Before this started after the pipe burst, had you ever gone through another period in your life when you felt depressed like this for at least two weeks?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had bad days or maybe a tough week here and there, like anyone else. But nothing like this... nothing that lasted for weeks or just dragged on and on like this has. This is the first time it's been this bad.
Do you feel your reaction to having to move into the smaller apartment has been much stronger than most people would have in the same situation?

I don't really know how other people would react, honestly. I mean, nobody likes moving, especially when they don't plan to. But... I guess maybe my reaction has been stronger? I just know that it completely derailed me, and I haven't been able to get back on track since. I can't really say if it's worse than what someone else would feel, just that it's been really hard for me.
Nearly every day lately, have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I have. Most days I just wake up with this... flat, heavy sadness. The things that used to kind of reset me or make me feel better just don't do it anymore. Like, I used to like putting on a record, or cooking, or just tinkering with my electronics, but now... it's like none of that reaches me anymore. I just don't care about doing any of it.
Have you been feeling worried or on edge most days, even when nothing specific is happening?

No, not really. I wouldn't say I feel worried or on edge. It's not really a nervous feeling... it's more just that heavy, flat sadness I mentioned earlier. I don't really sit around feeling anxious when nothing is happening, I just mostly feel drained.
Has this been making it hard for you to function at work?

Yeah, it has. I mean, I'm still working, but... I've actually had to ask for some accommodations lately. I've been making mistakes in my documentation, which is something I normally wouldn't do, so I've had to ask for extra review on my work. And outside of work, it's just... keeping up with my normal routine just feels a lot harder. I've been skipping some of my regular board-game nights, and I just generally leave the apartment a lot less than I used to. It's just harder to do things right now.
Have there been times during this past year when the depression lasted for at least two weeks even though nothing about the apartment situation had recently gotten worse?

No, I wouldn't say so. The heavy sadness I've been feeling... it's really tied to this whole apartment thing. When things are quiet and nothing new has gone wrong with the place, I don't usually feel like this for weeks on end. It's really just when the situation flares up that I feel this way.
